dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible are three prominent high-contrast structures: a central elliptical 'O' structure with a sharp light-intensity perimeter and dark interior, a ventral 'C' shaped arc located below the central O, and a smaller, highly defined circular ring on the posterior-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters, located primarily in the anterior-ventral region where the texture transitions from discrete rings to irregular stippling.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest edge oriented along the horizontal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: An interconnected double-loop or 'figure-eight' structure is visible on the far posterior flank near the edge of the visible frame.
